title: Pairing with an Outer Product
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be an $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $x,y$ be vectors of length $n$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The pairing of $A$ with the outer product whose $(i,j)$ entry is $x_i y_j$ equals $\sum_{i,j} A_{ij}x_i y_j$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ and $y$ are vectors of length $n$ over $\mathbb{F}_2$
